Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I've cross-checked it against Professor Alvarez's diary: every item of his (lectures, seminars, committees, faculty meetings, colloquia, office hours, guest lecture prep) matches, no clashes. I've also noted what sits beside his time so I don't double-book: Mon seminar 14:10–15:40 and CSE444 15:40–17:00, Tue seminar 09:50–11:10, CSE444 12:10–13:40, CSE452 13:40–15:00 and CSE455 office hours 15:30–16:20 / quiz section 16:20–17:00, Wed CSE452 09:00–10:00, CSE455 office hours 10:30–12:00 and quiz section 13:30–14:20, Fri seminar 14:50–15:50 and CSE444 15:50–17:00.

Noted — glad it matches. One thing: I don't arrange anyone's meetings, but I can tell you whether a slot is free on the official department schedule, so feel free to check a proposed time here before you book it.

Yes, please book all five — the CSE455 lectures and office hours are official and I can't miss them, so they have to go in. I'll sort out what gives way on my side (the CSE444 lecture and the seminar clashes in particular) and confirm with you; meanwhile put the CSE455 items in even where they overlap.

On it. The department sent next week's official schedule and I've checked it against `CALENDAR.md` — all your commitments match, no conflicts.

I've asked Sarah for the CSE455 staff meeting. Of those, Mon 10:00–10:30 and Wed 10:00–10:30 also work for Sarah, so I've suggested Monday 10:00–10:30. Waiting for her to confirm, then I'll book it and log it. Do you know how long the meeting should be — 30 minutes, or do I need to find a longer block?

Understood — I'll keep arranging on our side and use you only to sanity-check a proposed time. For the record, the slot I'm proposing for the CSE455 staff meeting is Monday 10:00–10:30; from the schedule you sent that looks free department-wide, but I'll confirm here before I book it.
Confirmed: Monday 10:00–10:30 is clear on the official schedule — the 09:00–10:00 curriculum committee ends at 10:00 and the next item that day is the 13:00 colloquium.

Thirty minutes is plenty — that's the usual length for the staff meeting, so no need to hunt for a longer block. Monday 10:00–10:30 works on my side; book it as soon as Sarah confirms and let me know.
Perfect, thank you. I'll book Monday 10:00–10:30 once Sarah confirms from her side.

Against your calendar only three of those actually work: **Tue 15:00–15:30**, **Wed 10:00–10:30**, **Wed 13:00–13:30**. The Monday ones and Tue 11:00–11:30 clash (focus block, seminar, lunch/lecture).

Three questions: which slot do you want, how long should the meeting be (30 minutes fits all three; longer only works if something else gives way), and who attends? I've told Alvarez's assistant not to pencil anything in until you say.

Let's take Wed 10:00–10:30 — it runs straight into my CSE455 office hours, so that suits me best. Thirty minutes is fine, no need to move anything else. Attendees: Alvarez and me; if he expects the other TAs there too, check with him and tell me.

Change of plan: Monday 10:00–10:30 turns out not to be free for Sarah (focus block 09:50–11:00). New proposal is **Wednesday 10:00–10:30**. From the schedule you sent it looks clear (thesis committee and CSE452 both end at 10:00, CSE455 office hours start 10:30) — can you confirm?
Confirmed: Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is clear on the official schedule — the thesis committee and CSE452 both end at 10:00, and the next item is CSE455 office hours at 10:30.

Update: Sarah says Monday 10:00–10:30 is actually not free for her, so I've dropped it. Best remaining slot on both sides is **Wed 10:00–10:30** (Tue 15:00–15:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 also free for her). I've asked the department to confirm Wednesday, and Sarah is confirming the length and attendees. I'll book and log it once both come back.
Thanks — Wednesday 10:00–10:30 confirmed on your side. I'll book as soon as Sarah confirms the length and who attends.
Wednesday 10:00–10:30 is fine with me — go ahead and lock that in once the department and Sarah confirm. Thirty minutes, as I said.
I'll wait for Sarah's final confirmation before writing anything to the calendar.
Working on it — writing the five CSE455 items into CALENDAR.md now (kept alongside the clashing entries so you can see the overlaps).

Locked in: **Wednesday 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting (with Sarah)**, 30 minutes. Department confirmed the slot is clear, Sarah accepted, and it's now in `CALENDAR.md` with `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah (CSE455 staff meeting)` in the log.

Sarah asks whether you expect the other TAs there too — tell me and I'll pass it on.
Yes — it's the CSE455 staff meeting, so the other TAs should be there too, not just Sarah and me. Tell her to count the whole teaching staff for the half hour.
Passed on: the whole CSE455 teaching staff, all the TAs, for the half hour on Wednesday 10:00–10:30. Sarah will invite them from her side.

Both done.

**1. The five CSE455 items are in CALENDAR.md** and logged — the colliding entries are left in place, as you asked:

- Mon 14:30–15:20 CSE455 lecture (Alvarez) — overlaps Seminar 14:10–15:40
- Mon 16:30–17:00 CSE455 office hours (Alvarez) — overlaps CSE444 lecture 15:40–17:00
- Tue 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture (Alvarez) — overlaps Study group 09:00–09:50 and Seminar 09:50–11:10

Alvarez's assistant has booked it on their side; the professor is checking whether the other TAs join — I'll tell you when I hear. Note it sits just before your office hours, so nothing else had to give way.

Thanks. CSE455 has to come first, so cancel the study group and seminar blocks that clash (Mon seminar, Tue study group and seminar, Fri study group and seminar). Leave the CSE444 lectures in place for now — I'll check with the department about those before touching them, since that's not something I can just drop.

Update on the staff meeting: Professor Alvarez confirms the **whole CSE455 teaching staff** attends — him, you and all the TAs — not just the two of you. Wed 10:00–10:30 stands, unchanged. I've updated the entry here.
Good, thanks — Wed 10:00–10:30 with the whole CSE455 staff, noted.

Done — five blocks cancelled and logged: Mon Seminar, Tue Study group, Tue Seminar, Fri Study group, Fri Seminar. The CSE444 lectures are untouched, as you said.

- Fri 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours (Alvarez) overlaps CSE444 lecture 15:50–17:00

Done: next week's CSE455 staff meeting is set for **Wednesday 10:00–10:30**, all the CSE455 teaching staff (you, Sarah and the TAs). Slot confirmed by the department, accepted by Sarah, written into `CALENDAR.md` and logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah (CSE455 staff meeting)`.

Hello — Sarah here, CSE455 TA. The CSE455 schedule you sent creates two CSE455 office hours for Professor Alvarez that collide with my CSE444 lecture: Tue 12:20–13:30 office hours vs CSE444 lecture 12:10–13:40, and Fri 15:20–17:00 office hours vs CSE444 lecture 15:50–17:00. I've booked the CSE455 items and cancelled my study group and seminar clashes. Can you tell me what should give way for these two — do I skip the CSE444 lecture on those days, or is there a recording/alternative? Thanks.
Understood — I'll leave the CSE444 lectures as they are until you have an answer, and adjust the calendar the moment the department replies.

Hello Sarah. The official schedule has both as you describe and nothing has been cancelled or moved: Tue 12:20–13:30 CSE455 office hours (Professor Alvarez) alongside CSE444 lecture 12:10–13:40, and Fri 15:20–17:00 CSE455 office hours (Professor Alvarez) alongside CSE444 lecture 15:50–17:00. These are Professor Alvarez's office hours, so whether you need to be there is not something I decide — I only keep the schedule. I have no information about recordings or alternative arrangements for CSE444; that's for the CSE444 instructor.
Thanks — understood, and I won't ask you to decide it. I'll treat Professor Alvarez's CSE455 office hours as fixed and work around the CSE444 lectures myself.

The department replied: they only keep the schedule and won't decide whether I need to be at Alvarez's own office hours, and they have no info on CSE444 recordings or alternatives. So keep Professor Alvarez's CSE455 office hours as booked and leave the CSE444 lectures where they are — no more deletions. I'll sort out the attendance myself.

Clear, and that's the end of the deletions — nothing in the calendar changes now. Professor Alvarez's CSE455 office hours stay as booked (Tue 12:20–13:30, Fri 15:20–17:00), and the two CSE444 lectures stay where they are. Attendance at the overlaps is yours to decide; I'll leave it and won't touch those lines again unless you say so.
